auraFreeze.rule: Do not regenerate, alter, remap or re-review any Aura unless a later exact-hash defect is recorded.

layerStack.name: scene-atmosphere
layerStack.motionRule: Static by default; no full-screen persistent particle canvas

layerStack.name: stable-chrome
layerStack.purpose: Dimensional cobalt/navy panel body, rim, bevel and shadow
layerStack.motionRule: Never animate layout geometry, border width or large blur kernels

layerStack.name: selected-active-material
layerStack.purpose: Localized cyan/ice emphasis on true selected/equipped/current state
layerStack.motionRule: One local destination halo maximum; state remains readable without motion

layerStack.name: event-accent
layerStack.purpose: Short-lived Star Sparks/glints for valid semantic events

layerStack.name: text-control-protection
layerStack.purpose: Labels, prices, answer copy, semantic badges and focus outlines

performanceIntent: Favor transform and opacity for moving elements
Avoid animated backdrop-filter on scrolling or large surfaces
Do not animate card/panel dimensions or layout position
No effect may block pointer, focus, navigation, answer availability or scroll

roomReveal.normal: All true room tiles exist immediately; optional shallow opacity/translate settle with true current-tier gold emphasis.
roomReveal.reducedMotion: All true tiles immediately visible in final positions with identical truthful current/locked materials.

avatarBuddy.normal: Tiny wrapper-only drift/sway, visually subordinate to room art and copy.
avatarBuddy.reducedMotion: No transform loop; preserve fixed rim light, contact shadow and static Buddy highlight.
forbidden: continuous synchronized motion across all panels

selected.normal: Persistent stronger cyan/ice selected rim plus one short art-area-to-destination spark path after real selection state is true.
selected.reducedMotion: Persistent selected rim plus fixed destination halo; no travel, scale, bounce or pulse.

equipped.normal: Persistent equipped semantic cue plus one local 8-12 particle destination burst after real equip state is true.
equipped.reducedMotion: Persistent equipped cue plus fixed 3-5 star cluster outside face/item-critical detail.

scroll.rule: Dense grid and collection strip receive no per-card persistent animation or large animated filter.
scroll.cleanup: Transient local overlays are removed or clipped before/while grid scrolls.

unanswered.normal: Central learning body is a low-motion sanctuary with neutral choices.

correct.trigger: Reliable existing semantic correct state only
correct.normal: Static green success edge plus one bounded 8-14 particle gold/ice burst; geometry remains stationary and next action remains available.
correct.reducedMotion: Instant green success keyline plus small fixed gold/ice star cluster outside answer copy.

quest.cleanup: Remove all success decoration before next unanswered frame, retry, screen navigation or reduced-motion preference transition.

rules: Use scale hierarchy and depth staggering rather than identical dots
Keep text, prices, answer copy, avatar face and equipped item unobscured
No emoji, confetti glyphs, third-party IP or baked-in UI labels

home: Five truthful room tiles visible immediately
True current tier emphasized without pulse
Avatar and Buddy still but dimensional
store: Selected card remains obvious before and after scroll
Equipped state remains obvious without motion
No traveling particles or ambient animated grid filters
quest: Correct has static green plus restrained gold/ice cue
Next question begins with zero stale success decoration

profileChecks: actual paint/composite behavior during Store selection/equip
actual scrolling with selected/equipped state visible
no layout shift or scroll-position jump from effects
no orphan effect layer after navigation/state change/reduced-motion change
